A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 28-page versions of the same SysDPO paper. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison cover the equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–M without material gaps.

before.justification: v3 reports original LLM–diffusion and compound-LLM experiments in Section 5, including Tables 1–3, and a three-LLM evaluation in Appendix D.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results, including the main comparisons, appendix training curves, qualitative examples, and three-LLM evaluation.

M1.justification: The DAG formulation, SysDPO-Direct and SysDPO-Sampling procedures, losses, diverse beam search, and diffusion-model adaptation are unchanged. Equations on pages 3–5 only shift position.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same image-sequence attribute-progression task and Intel/orca-dpo-pairs response-refinement data. Appendix examples and evaluated task coverage are identical.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: the image-system baselines in Table 1, Prompted System, Separate-DPO and stage-wise variants in Table 2, and DBS/MC comparisons in Table 3.

E3.justification: The dataset construction, 193-example LLM evaluation split, metrics, model configurations, training hyperparameters, and sampling settings are unchanged, including those reported for appendix experiments.

E4.justification: The component-freezing ablations, sampling comparisons, three-LLM extension, qualitative cases, and training-dynamics analyses are retained unchanged in Section 5 and Appendices D and I–M.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including Section 5.2.3's description of different seeds for Monte Carlo candidates. No repeated-run summaries, confidence intervals, or significance tests are added.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 and all appendix results are identical. Retained results include SysDPO-Direct's 0.25 Preference Score and 73% Order Consistency Ratio in Table 1 and the three-LLM system's 58% win rate in Appendix D.

T1.justification: Definition 1, Proposition 1, Assumption 1, Theorem 1, and the appendix proofs and derivations are unchanged. The reflowed equations introduce no mathematical revisions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about system-level alignment, the two SysDPO variants, theoretical guarantees, and empirical effectiveness.

C2.justification: Interpretations of component contributions, sampling diversity, and training behavior are unchanged. The limitations concerning computational cost, scaling, and extending beyond static DAGs are also retained.

D1.justification: v4 adds footnote 2 on page 2 stating that code is available and linking to the SysDPO GitHub repository. v3 lacks this access information; implementation and training details are otherwise unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to DPO, compound-system optimization, and other prior research are unchanged. The added repository pointer concerns this paper's own code.

P1.justification: v4 adds the short code-availability footnote and updates the arXiv version/date labeling. Main prose, terminology, section order, and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added footnote causes local spacing and page-break changes on pages 2–5. Figures and tables retain their contents and designs; pages 6–28 render identically.

improvement.justification: The new code-access pointer modestly improves reproducibility documentation by giving readers an implementation location absent from v3. Scientific content and evidence are unchanged. The supplied PDFs do not establish the linked repository's completeness or usability.
